abstract: The effect of methotrexate (MTX) on the growth and human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) secretion of five gestational and two nongestational human choriocarcinoma cell lines was studied in vitro. A striking heterogeneity in hCG secretion was noted among the cell lines. The growth of cells which secreted large quantities of hCG, such as HCCM-5, BeWo, and IMa, was inhibited by continuous exposure to 2 X 10(-8)M MTX. In contrast, cells which secreted little hCG, such as SCH, ENAMI-1, and GCH-1, showed no response to the growth inhibitory action of 2 X 10(-8)M MTX and the 3H-thymidine uptake was not reduced by treatment with MTX at doses of up to 10(-4)M for 48 hours. The common morphologic alterations observed in the cells which responded to MTX were an increase in the number of multinucleated giant cells, the appearance of vacuoles and granules in the cytoplasm, and enlargement of the nuclei. Increased hCG secretion was observed in accordance with the appearance of such morphologically altered cells. Part of the mechanisms of resistance to MTX appeared to involve both impairment of MTX uptake by the cells and an increase in the level of intracellular dihydrofolate reductase.
abstract_ja: 本研究では、妊娠性5株および非妊娠性2株のヒト絨毛癌細胞株において、メトトレキサート(MTX)が増殖およびヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)分泌に及ぼす影響をin vitroで検討した。hCG分泌には細胞株間で顕著な不均一性が認められた。HCCM-5、BeWo、IMaなどhCGを多量に分泌する細胞株の増殖は、2×10^-8 MのMTXの持続曝露により抑制された。一方、SCH、ENAMI-1、GCH-1などhCG分泌の少ない細胞株は、2×10^-8 MのMTXに対する増殖抑制応答を示さず、10^-4 Mまで48時間処理しても3H-チミジン取り込みは低下しなかった。MTXに応答した細胞に共通する形態学的変化は、多核巨細胞の増加、細胞質内の空胞および顆粒の出現、核の拡大であった。このような形態学的に変化した細胞の出現に伴い、hCG分泌の増加が認められた。MTX耐性の機序の一部には、細胞によるMTX取り込みの障害と、細胞内ジヒドロ葉酸還元酵素レベルの上昇が関与すると考えられた。
